Pambill Features | Automated Invoicing, EU VAT & Multi-Shop Management Help and Support Help Knowledgebase --> English EN Deutsch English Español Français Polski Login CREATE ACCOUNT Toggle navigation Features Pricing News API Contact Partners About us Features overview Fully automatic invoicing for Shopify and Jimdo With a PRO package, PamBill does all the invoicing for you. Each order is imported, invoice generated and sent to the buyer by e-mail, including the delivery note if needed. This allows you to devote your time to more important work, while PamBill does the invoicing (1) (2) (1) Fully automatic invoicing is supported for Shopify, Jimdo Creator and Jimdo Dolphin (2) For automatic Shopify order import an additional monthly fee is required Flexible manual invoicing Create invoice, preview and download PDF or send to the customer, all in single clicks, all packages. PamBill suggests the VAT rate and calculates the totals. Add a discount, change the currency, find the customer or a product by typing a few letters. Add a note or an image / QR-code, switch between invoice templates. Edit any invoice, whether imported or manually created, unless it has been paid or refunded. Import from Shopify, Webflow, Squarespace, Thinkific, Jimdo Creator and Dolphin Drop a CSV or XML file containing orders to PamBill dashboard for duplicate-free import from any of your web shops. Multiple shops of the same type are supported. PamBill app for Shopify If you have a Shopify online store, the invoicing process is fully automatic with PamBill. Our Shopify app will import all existing orders, and send new orders to PamBill in real time. PamBill app in the Shopify store ⇢ Business templates for invoices PamBill comes with a set of three business templates, each with two versions for Net and Gross pricing, and a set of customization options. Invoices are fully localized and support all the languages available in PamBill. European Union One Stop Shop PamBill supports One Stop Shop in all packages that include VAT function. OSS needs to be used, if your business is registered in the EU and your net sales to private persons in other EU-countries is over 10.000 Euro per calendar year. In OSS mode, PamBill applies applicable VAT rates based on the customer's country and will automatically correct VAT percentages at import and during manual invoicing. Electronic invoicing PamBill automatically generates EN16931 -compliant XRechnung electronic invoices. The XML file is automatically attached when you send an invoice to the customer from PamBill, if both you and your customer are EU-based companies. E-invoices can be downloaded by hand, and are included into PamBill-created archives of invoices and user data. Legally correct invoices With attention to detail and legal requirements, we control the VAT rate in specific cases, including One Stop Shop (EU OSS), EU VAT exemption when selling B2B, no VAT when selling from EU to non-EU states. We check user-entered EU VAT numbers in VIES , and let you know if your VAT settings are incorrect. Automatic payment reminders Automatically mark unpaid invoices as overdue and send up to 3 payment reminders. Up to two penalty fees can be set up to go with the reminders. Delivery and credit notes Delivery notes can be downloaded or included when sending the invoice by e-mail. Credit notes are available for refunded and partially refunded invoices. Delivery in parts PamBill allows you to select which products to include into each delivery note. The product is then marked as delivered, so you won't include the same product twice. Currencies and languages PamBill's interface and invoicing are available in 5 languages: English, German, French, Polish and Spanish. We support both invoicing and import in all world currencies (ISO 4217) , selectable per invoice. The currency is specific to invoice, allowing you issue invoices in more than one currency in one PamBill account. Reports PamBill offers various reports on sales, top customers and much more. With this you can keep your Shopify, Jimdo or Squarespace store perfectly in view. Our reports allow you to select time ranges, so you can easily determine quarterly or annual sales. Among the reports are: Revenue (paid & refunded) Revenue (top customers) Invoice statistics Sales per country (EU only) Sales per region VAT per country (EU only) Printed & sent invoices Unpaid invoices Paid invoices Unlimited number of shops With any PamBill package you can create any number of shops. Shops are used to group invoices and products. Each shop may have its own EU VAT number and logo to be printed on the invoices. Unlimited number of products Products are shop-specific and automatically maintained. PamBill automatically suggests products when you start typing their name, SKU or variant on the invoice. When the product is selected, it is added to the invoice, with its name, SKU, variant, price and VAT type. Unlimited number of customers PamBill automatically creates customers from the imported orders and suggests them when creating invoices. When customer has an EU VAT number, the VAT will be exempt with the respective notice. Billing address, payment type and currency are auto-inserted when selecting the customer. Import from any shop system with PamBill API PamBill API allows for simple and reliable import of order and customer data from any shop system or data source. Note that PamBill PRO package is required to use the API, and you may need a developer to implement sending the orders. Check PamBill API documentation here ⇢ Packages & pricing PamBill offers 3 simple and distinctive subscription packages . About Pambill | Automated Invoicing for E-commerce & Shopify Help and Support Help Knowledgebase --> English EN Deutsch English Español Français Polski Login CREATE ACCOUNT Toggle navigation Features Pricing News API Contact Partners About us About us We are PamConsult GmbH, your partner for stress-free invoicing! As a team from near Munich, Germany, we have been rocking the market since 2006 with clever online solutions that make your life easier. Our motto? Simplicity meets productivity! We develop tools that help you get more done without losing your head. You may already be familiar with PamFax, our super simple online fax service that lets you send faxes worldwide. Originally developed with Skype and launched via Skype, PamFax has been a global online solution since 2006. PamBill: Writing invoices? No longer a problem! And now to our star: PamBill! Do you know this? You have a cool online shop, but all that stuff with invoices, taxes and paperwork is annoying? That's exactly why we built PamBill! Originally started as a little helper for Jimdo users in 2015 because the Jimdo Shop system couldn't create PDF invoices, PamBill is now a fully-fledged invoicing powerhouse. We teamed up with Jimdo back then to make life easier for shop owners - and the feedback has been tremendous! Our large customer base in Germany, Austria and Switzerland have helped us to constantly improve PamBill. From a small tool to an all-rounder! Since the launch, we have upgraded PamBill with countless features. We started with the Jimdo import, but over time we've expanded support to Webflow, Squarespace, Thinkific and Shopify. For Shopify, we even offer a fully automated integration using our own PamBill-Shopify app ! Just imagine: You can import your data from Jimdo Creator and Dolphin fully automatically - we were the first and are still the only ones to offer a fully automated Jimdo import! You can also send invoices automatically by email, have a smart payment reminder system, create delivery notes and credit notes, use SMTP server support for sending emails via your own server and benefit from many other productivity features. And yes, we have even integrated the one-stop shop rules! As you can see, a small tool has become a mega-powerful solution that really takes a lot of work off your hands - even manual invoicing is no problem! And the best thing? PamBill is multi-shop capable! No matter how many shops you run, you can easily manage them all from a single PamBill account. Globally ready and fairly priced! PamBill adapts to your shop size, whether you are a small business owner or run a larger shop. We have customized prices for every shop size, so you always pay exactly what you need. And don't worry about hidden costs: we offer you a fixed sum per month, all-inclusive. So you always know exactly what to expect! Oh yes, and we support all currencies - so you are globally positioned! PamBill speaks your language: PamBill is available in English, German, French, Polish and Spanish, and takes country-specific requirements into account. Are you curious? Great! Try PamBill for 30 days free of charge and without obligation. No credit card required, no automatic renewal. If you don't want to use it, the trial simply expires. And if you want to get started, you can reset your account at any time to delete all test data and start clean! By the way, you can find more information about our solution at: www.pambill.com Test PamBill without obligation No credit card required, no automatic renewal.
